children: Jito plans to open third-party BAM nodes to any Solana validator in Q1 2027. The open validator access phase will allow validators to connect trustlessly. It depends on mainnet attestations and on the Verifier and Autobahn going live on mainnet.
The expansion completes the decentralization of Jito's block-building layer by making trustless connections to third-party BAM nodes available across the Solana validator network.

title: Jito: BAM opens trustless access to any Solana validator - Q1 2027
